hooks.name: Verify Coding Conventions
hooks.description: Reminds to follow project conventions when creating new files

action.prompt: A new code file was created. Verify it follows the project conventions: For Python files - ensure async functions have type hints, follow layered architecture (endpoint → service → repository), and use proper naming (snake_case files, PascalCase classes). For TypeScript files - ensure proper imports with @/ prefix, named exports for components, TailwindCSS for styling, and proper interface definitions for props.
